decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a new swing check valve.

items.material_name: DN 65 PN 10 swing check valve with weighted lever
items.description: Swing check valve with lever and counterweight.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of new automatic air release valves.

items.material_name: Compact PN 10 automatic air release valve, G 3/4 inlet × G 1/2 A outlet, 0–2 bar, 130 °C, with air inlet shutoff
items.description: Standard float-operated valve for potable water pressure lines, with EPDM housing seal and FPM valve seal.

decisions.reason: The position requires one complete air filtration unit; the filter elements and mounting accessories are included components.

items.material_name: 1.4571 stainless steel supply and exhaust air filtration unit, F7 and H13, DN 150 interfaces, ≥250 m³/h, 800 Pa filter burst pressure
items.description: Clean-water chamber filtration unit with service cover, condensate drains, LCD differential pressure gauge and wall brackets.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of a new exterior ventilation louver.

items.material_name: 1.4571 stainless steel fixed-blade exterior weather louver, DN 150 adapter, ≥250 m³/h, for approximately 200 mm wall thickness
items.description: Rain-resistant louver with overlapping welded Z-blades, a 40 × 45 × 25 × 2 mm Z-frame and removable 1 × 1 mm insect mesh.

decisions.reason: The position requires supply and installation of new pressure and vacuum relief valves with included pipe connections.

items.material_name: Building pressure and vacuum relief valve, 1.4301 stainless steel housing or better, 650 Pa in both directions, ≥300 m³/h, DN 150 branch connection
items.description: Maintenance-free valve with a stainless steel branch and either a flanged joint or a restrained pipe coupling.
